mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_vector( course_no, title, content, instructor_no, chunk_no, embedding ) VALUES ( #{course_no}, #{title}, #{content}, #{instructor_no}, #{chunk_no}, #{embedding}::vector )

INSERT INTO question_vector ( question_no, title, description, theme, type, difficulty, answer, option1, option2, option3, option4, content, embedding ) VALUES ( #{question_no}, #{title}, #{description}, #{theme}, #{type}, #{difficulty}, #{answer}, #{option1}, #{option2}, #{option3}, #{option4}, #{content}, #{embedding}::vector )
ON CONFLICT(question_no) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title, description=EXCLUDED.description, theme=EXCLUDED.theme, type=EXCLUDED.type, difficulty=EXCLUDED.difficulty, answer=EXCLUDED.answer, option1=EXCLUDED.option1, option2=EXCLUDED.option2, option3=EXCLUDED.option3, option4=EXCLUDED.option4, content=EXCLUDED.content, embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding
